title: A/E Services for Dow Towers Rehabilitation Project
short_description: Architectural and engineering services for rehabilitating a 76-unit public residential building.
project_scope: Rehabilitation of Dow Towers, a publicly owned 76-unit residential building in Hopkins, Minnesota. The notice indicates a building rehabilitation project but provides no gross floor area, height, structural system, or other technical characteristics.
services: Professional architectural and engineering services including architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, and electrical engineering for building rehabilitation/refurbishment.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing building rehabilitation/refurbishment, which is generally less relevant than new complex structures for sbp.
- Residential building project with no indication of large spans, special structural systems, or innovative lightweight design.
- Includes structural engineering, but the overall scope is broad A/E building rehabilitation rather than a distinct challenging structural assignment.
- No evidence of sustainability innovation, special materials, or architecturally demanding long-span structures.
